evidence: Changes CCoinsMap hashing behavior in src/coins.h and carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label affecting the coins cache.
rationale: The change offers a modest performance improvement during IBD and snapshot loading at the cost of slight memory overhead. Benchmarks show a ~2% speedup in reindex-chainstate and up to 11% faster AssumeUTXO loading under GCC/libstdc++, but the optimization is incremental and reasonably deferrable.
